# <Module> Module

## Purpose

State the module's independently owned responsibility.

## Owns

List durable owned capability/state/rules at responsibility level.

## Does not own

List nearby responsibilities whose ownership must remain explicit.

## Public boundary

Describe the collaboration boundary and link the authoritative API source.

## Private implementation boundary

Describe the hidden implementation boundary and link implementation/persistence authorities where applicable.

## Dependencies

List allowed public module/foundation dependencies and forbidden private dependencies.

## Related authorities

Link module model, architecture model, API/build/migration/contract authorities as applicable without duplicating their truth.
